subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of the requested native core surfaces now: file/search batching, AI-callable context blocks, or runner-enforced submitted plans?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, context/session persistence semantics, and config/enforcement policy while VISION.md only partially aligns and warns against heavy orchestration or optional capability in core.

options.title: Split For Design Review
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for whichever surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Route Plugin-Feasible Pieces First
options.body: Defer core changes unless a plugin, context-engine, or tool API gap is proven, using existing plugin seams and context-engine hooks where adequate.

options.title: Decline The Broad Direction
options.body: Close only after a maintainer decides the combined native batching, context-block, and plan-enforcement direction is not planned for core.

recommendation.title: Split For Design Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for whichever surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across update_plan, strict-agentic behavior, and the agent-runtime/tool boundaries implicated by this request.
